checks.ref: command:count=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$count" = "1" ] || { echo "expected exactly one active change under openspec/changes/, found $count"; exit 1; }

command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
outside=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v "^$change/" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$outside" ] || { echo "$outside"; echo "the specify stage writes only under $change/ - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: Test placement violates .claude/rules/bdd-unit.md, whose table marks 'Keyboard accessibility | no (unit) | yes (E2E)' and 'aria-labels, focus management | no | yes'; the acceptance criteria repeat it: 'keyboard, layout, real-browser behaviour in E2E, not in jsdom'. Tasks 5.1/5.2 (and design D5) still add locations_search_shortcut_unit.feature, a vitest-cucumber feature that tests the '/' keyboard shortcut in jsdom: synthetic keydowns, focus() on an input/textarea/contenteditable it appends itself, and 'focus on its close action' for FR3. The task only requires plain unit tests for the ignore cases (already in tasks 2.1/3.1/4.2). Remove the unit BDD feature or limit it to non-keyboard rules, and cover FR6 (unreadable list) another way, e.g. a component test.

proposal.md Impact claims `constants/` gets 'the `/` key and DOM constants', but design.md D2/D3 make CONTENT_EDITABLE_SELECTOR, NON_TEXT_INPUT_TYPES and KEYDOWN_EVENT module-local ('Both constants are module-local'), and tasks.md only adds KeyboardKey.SLASH to constants/keyboard.ts. The proposal and design disagree; make them consistent.

NFR-R1 says 'the 8 approved screenshots of the list and empty states at 375 px and 1024 px in both themes', but the repository has 16 such baselines: 8 under src/test/features/__screenshots__/chromium/ and 8 under __screenshots__/mobile-chrome/. M5 counts them differently ('8 list and empty screenshot examples (run in both the chromium and mobile-chrome projects)'). Fix the count in NFR-R1 so it agrees with M5 and the files.

Task 5.2 says to append the text-entry elements to document.body and 'remove it in BeforeEachScenario/AfterEachScenario with closeApp', but closeApp in steps/locationsUiWorld.tsx is only `cleanup(); localStorage.clear();`. RTL cleanup() unmounts only containers it rendered, so the manually appended input/textarea/contenteditable elements are never removed. The task relies on helper behaviour that does not exist and should remove the elements explicitly.
